"""The four charts, drawn as plain SVG (the same drawings as the original site).

Each function returns ui.HTML(...) holding one <svg> picture. A few things to know:
  - x grows to the right; y grows DOWNWARDS from the top of the picture.
  - Colours are CSS variables from styles.css (var(--amber), var(--cedar), ...),
    so the charts switch to dark mode along with the rest of the page.
  - A <title> inside a shape is the tooltip you see when hovering with a mouse.
  - onclick="go(...)" / onclick="pickDay(...)" call the functions in clicks.js.
"""
import math
from datetime import timedelta
from html import escape

from shiny import ui

from data import SEASONS, all_days, average_gal, on_shared_calendar
from french import NBSP, MONTHS, day_number, number, short_date, temperature, weekday_short

# The page tells us its width; a chart is narrower by the card's padding
# (20px on each side) and border (1px on each side).
CARD_INSET = 42
MIN_WIDTH = 300


def chart_width(page_width):
    """How wide (in pixels) to draw a chart, given the page's width."""
    if not page_width:
        return 360  # a phone-sized guess until the browser reports the real width
    return max(MIN_WIDTH, round(page_width - CARD_INSET))


def svg(width, height, label, shapes):
    """Wrap a list of SVG shapes into one <svg> picture."""
    return ui.HTML(
        f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" width="{width}" height="{height}" '
        f'role="img" aria-label="{escape(label)}">' + "".join(shapes) + "</svg>"
    )


def clamp(value, low, high):
    """Keep value between low and high."""
    return max(low, min(high, value))


def year_label(x, y, year):
    """The bold year written at the left of a row."""
    return f'<text x="{x}" y="{y:.1f}" style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--ink-2)">{year}</text>'


# ============================================================ season page

# Every season uses the same scales, so flipping between years compares like with like.
_lows = [w["lo"] for s in SEASONS for w in s["weather"]]
_highs = [w["hi"] for s in SEASONS for w in s["weather"]]
_gallons = [day["gal"] or 0 for s in SEASONS for day in s["days"]]
TEMP_LOW = math.floor(min(_lows) / 10) * 10     # e.g. −30
TEMP_HIGH = math.ceil(max(_highs) / 10) * 10    # e.g. 20
GAL_MAX = math.ceil(max(_gallons) / 10) * 10    # e.g. 40


def season_chart(s, selected_day, width):
    """Day by day, 15 Feb to 20 Apr.

    Top panel:    a bar from each day's night low up to its day high.
                  Green = sap weather (froze at night, thawed by day).
    Bottom panel: gallons of syrup boiled that day (amber bars).
                  A small circle marks a logbook day with no syrup.
    Tap any column to pick that day.
    """
    days = s["weather"]                                # one entry per calendar day
    logbook = {day["date"]: day for day in s["days"]}  # date -> logbook line
    column_of = {w["d"]: i for i, w in enumerate(days)}

    # --- layout, in pixels
    left, right = 34, 6                        # room for the axis numbers
    temp_top, temp_height = 18, 150            # temperature panel
    syrup_top, syrup_height = temp_top + temp_height + 34, 92
    syrup_bottom = syrup_top + syrup_height
    height = syrup_bottom + 26                 # room for the date labels

    step = (width - left - right) / len(days)  # width of one day's column
    bar = clamp(step * 0.62, 2, 9)             # width of the bars in it
    corner = min(bar / 2, 3)

    def column_left(i):
        return left + i * step

    def column_center(i):
        return left + (i + 0.5) * step

    def temp_y(t):
        return temp_top + (TEMP_HIGH - t) / (TEMP_HIGH - TEMP_LOW) * temp_height

    def syrup_y(gal):
        return syrup_bottom - gal / GAL_MAX * syrup_height

    shapes = []  # drawn in order, so later shapes sit on top

    # Amber band behind the days the fire was going
    first = column_of.get(s["start"], 0)
    last = column_of.get(s["end"], len(days) - 1)
    shapes.append(
        f'<rect x="{column_left(first):.1f}" y="{temp_top - 6}" width="{(last - first + 1) * step:.1f}" '
        f'height="{syrup_bottom - temp_top + 6}" fill="var(--amber-tint)" rx="4"/>'
    )

    # Temperature grid lines every 10 degrees
    for t in range(TEMP_LOW, TEMP_HIGH + 1, 10):
        line_class = "zero" if t == 0 else "grid"
        label = f"−{-t}" if t < 0 else str(t)
        shapes.append(f'<line class="{line_class}" x1="{left}" x2="{width - right}" y1="{temp_y(t):.1f}" y2="{temp_y(t):.1f}"/>')
        shapes.append(f'<text x="{left - 6}" y="{temp_y(t) + 4:.1f}" text-anchor="end">{label}°</text>')
    shapes.append(f'<text class="panel-label" x="{left}" y="{temp_top - 8}">Min. de nuit → max. de jour (°C)</text>')

    # Syrup grid lines at 0, half and full scale
    for gal in (0, GAL_MAX / 2, GAL_MAX):
        line_class = "zero" if gal == 0 else "grid"
        shapes.append(f'<line class="{line_class}" x1="{left}" x2="{width - right}" y1="{syrup_y(gal):.1f}" y2="{syrup_y(gal):.1f}"/>')
        shapes.append(f'<text x="{left - 6}" y="{syrup_y(gal) + 4:.1f}" text-anchor="end">{number(gal)}</text>')
    shapes.append(f'<text class="panel-label" x="{left}" y="{syrup_top - 10}">Sirop produit (gal)</text>')

    # Dashed outline around the picked day
    if selected_day in column_of:
        i = column_of[selected_day]
        shapes.append(
            f'<rect class="sel" x="{column_left(i) + 0.5:.1f}" y="{temp_top - 6}" width="{max(step - 1, 3):.1f}" '
            f'height="{syrup_bottom - temp_top + 6}" rx="3"/>'
        )

    # The bars for each day
    best_gal = max(day["gal"] or 0 for day in s["days"])
    for i, w in enumerate(days):
        x = column_center(i) - bar / 2
        colour = "var(--cedar)" if w["sap"] else "var(--bar-neutral)"
        top, bottom = temp_y(w["hi"]), temp_y(w["lo"])
        shapes.append(
            f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{top:.1f}" width="{bar:.1f}" height="{max(bottom - top, 2):.1f}" '
            f'rx="{corner:.1f}" fill="{colour}"/>'
        )

        entry = logbook.get(w["d"])
        if entry and entry["gal"]:
            top = syrup_y(entry["gal"])
            shapes.append(
                f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{top:.1f}" width="{bar:.1f}" height="{syrup_bottom - top:.1f}" '
                f'rx="{corner:.1f}" fill="var(--amber)"/>'
            )
            if entry["gal"] == best_gal:  # label the season's biggest day
                label_x = clamp(column_center(i), left + 16, width - right - 16)
                shapes.append(f'<text class="lbl-strong" x="{label_x:.1f}" y="{top - 6:.1f}" text-anchor="middle">{number(entry["gal"], 1)}</text>')
        elif entry:
            shapes.append(
                f'<circle cx="{column_center(i):.1f}" cy="{syrup_bottom - 5}" r="3" '
                f'fill="none" stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-width="1.5"/>'
            )

    # Date labels on the 1st and 15th of each month
    for i, w in enumerate(days):
        month, day = int(w["d"][5:7]), int(w["d"][8:10])
        if day in (1, 15):
            x = column_center(i)
            shapes.append(f'<line class="grid" x1="{x:.1f}" x2="{x:.1f}" y1="{syrup_bottom}" y2="{syrup_bottom + 5}"/>')
            shapes.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{syrup_bottom + 18}" text-anchor="middle">{day_number(day)} {MONTHS[month - 1]}</text>')

    # Invisible, clickable columns on top of everything, one per day
    for i, w in enumerate(days):
        shapes.append(
            f'<rect class="hit" x="{column_left(i):.1f}" y="0" width="{step:.2f}" height="{height}" '
            f'onclick="pickDay(\'{w["d"]}\')"><title>{escape(day_tooltip(w, logbook.get(w["d"])))}</title></rect>'
        )

    return svg(width, height, f"Écart de température quotidien et sirop produit, saison {s['year']}", shapes)


def day_tooltip(w, entry):
    """Hover text for one day: "sam. 4 avr. · −1 °C → 6 °C · 26,5 gal produits"."""
    text = f"{weekday_short(w['d'])} {short_date(w['d'])} · {temperature(w['lo'])} → {temperature(w['hi'])}"
    if w["sap"]:
        text += " · jour de coulée"
    if entry and entry["gal"]:
        text += f" · {number(entry['gal'], 2)}{NBSP}gal produits"
    elif entry:
        text += " · entrée au cahier"
    return text


# ============================================================ all-seasons page

def yield_chart(width):
    """One amber column per season: gallons of syrup. Dashed line = the average."""
    height = 220
    left, right, top, bottom = 8, 54, 28, 28
    average = average_gal()
    best = max(SEASONS, key=lambda s: s["totalGal"])
    scale_max = math.ceil(best["totalGal"] / 50) * 50  # round up to the next 50

    def y(gal):
        return top + (1 - gal / scale_max) * (height - top - bottom)

    slot = (width - left - right) / len(SEASONS)  # room for each season
    bar = min(64, slot * 0.6)

    shapes = [
        f'<line class="zero" x1="{left}" x2="{width - right}" y1="{y(0):.1f}" y2="{y(0):.1f}"/>',
        f'<line x1="{left}" x2="{width - right + 6}" y1="{y(average):.1f}" y2="{y(average):.1f}" '
        f'stroke="var(--ink-2)" stroke-width="1.25" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>',
        f'<text x="{width}" y="{y(average) + 4:.1f}" text-anchor="end" '
        f'style="fill:var(--ink-2);font-weight:600">moy. {number(average)}</text>',
    ]

    for i, s in enumerate(SEASONS):
        x = left + i * slot + (slot - bar) / 2
        bar_top = y(s["totalGal"])
        star = "★ " if s is best else ""
        opacity = 1 if s is best else 0.72
        tooltip = (f"{s['year']} · {s['title']}\n{number(s['totalGal'], 2)}{NBSP}gal · "
                   f"{number(s['butterPots'])} pots de beurre\n{s['boilDays']} journées de bouillage")
        # A column with rounded top corners: up the left side, curve, across, curve, down.
        column = (f"M{x:.1f},{y(0):.1f} V{bar_top + 4:.1f} q0,-4 4,-4 h{bar - 8:.1f} "
                  f"q4,0 4,4 V{y(0):.1f} Z")
        shapes.append(
            f'<g onclick="go(\'season\', {s["year"]})"><title>{escape(tooltip)}</title>'
            f'<rect class="hit" x="{left + i * slot:.1f}" y="0" width="{slot:.1f}" height="{height}"/>'
            f'<path d="{column}" fill="var(--amber)" opacity="{opacity}"/>'
            f'<text class="lbl-strong" x="{x + bar / 2:.1f}" y="{bar_top - 8:.1f}" text-anchor="middle">{star}{number(s["totalGal"])}</text>'
            f'<text x="{x + bar / 2:.1f}" y="{height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" '
            f'style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--ink-2)">{s["year"]}</text></g>'
        )

    return svg(width, height, "Gallons de sirop par saison", shapes)


def timing_chart(width):
    """One row per season (newest on top) on a shared calendar.

    A faint line runs from the first fire to the last; each dot is a boiling day,
    bigger when more syrup was made. Tap a dot to open that day.
    """
    rows = list(reversed(SEASONS))
    left, right, top, row_height = 44, 12, 8, 42
    height = top + row_height * len(rows) + 26

    # Calendar range: at least 15 Feb to 20 Apr, wider if a season went past it
    starts = [on_shared_calendar(s["start"]) for s in rows]
    ends = [on_shared_calendar(s["end"]) for s in rows]
    first_day = min([on_shared_calendar("2024-02-15")] + starts) - timedelta(days=2)
    last_day = max([on_shared_calendar("2024-04-20")] + ends) + timedelta(days=2)
    total_days = (last_day - first_day).days

    def x(iso):
        days_in = (on_shared_calendar(iso) - first_day).days
        return left + days_in / total_days * (width - left - right)

    biggest = max(day["gal"] or 0 for day in all_days())

    def dot_radius(gal):
        return 2 + math.sqrt(gal / biggest) * 5.5

    shapes = []

    # Grid line + label on the 1st and 15th of each month
    for n in range(total_days + 1):
        d = first_day + timedelta(days=n)
        if d.day in (1, 15):
            line_class = "zero" if d.day == 1 else "grid"
            px = x(d.isoformat())
            shapes.append(f'<line class="{line_class}" x1="{px:.1f}" x2="{px:.1f}" y1="{top}" y2="{top + row_height * len(rows)}"/>')
            shapes.append(f'<text x="{px:.1f}" y="{height - 8}" text-anchor="middle">{day_number(d.day)} {MONTHS[d.month - 1]}</text>')

    for row, s in enumerate(rows):
        cy = top + row * row_height + row_height / 2
        shapes.append(year_label(0, cy + 4, s["year"]))
        shapes.append(
            f'<line x1="{x(s["start"]):.1f}" x2="{x(s["end"]):.1f}" y1="{cy:.1f}" y2="{cy:.1f}" '
            f'stroke="var(--amber)" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        )
        for day in s["days"]:
            if not day["gal"]:
                continue
            cx = x(day["date"])
            tooltip = f"{short_date(day['date'])} {s['year']}\n{number(day['gal'], 2)}{NBSP}gal produits"
            shapes.append(
                f'<g onclick="go(\'season\', {s["year"]}, \'{day["date"]}\')" style="cursor:pointer">'
                f'<title>{escape(tooltip)}</title>'
                f'<circle cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{cy:.1f}" r="{dot_radius(day["gal"]):.1f}" '
                f'fill="var(--amber)" stroke="var(--card)" stroke-width="1.5"/>'
                f'<circle class="hit" cx="{cx:.1f}" cy="{cy:.1f}" r="9"/></g>'  # bigger, invisible tap target
            )

    return svg(width, height, "Journées de bouillage de chaque saison sur un même calendrier", shapes)


def sap_chart(width):
    """One green bar per season: how many sap-weather days it had."""
    rows = list(reversed(SEASONS))
    left, right, row_height = 44, 104, 34
    height = row_height * len(rows)
    most = max(s["sapDaysWindow"] for s in rows)

    shapes = []
    for i, s in enumerate(rows):
        cy = i * row_height + row_height / 2
        length = (s["sapDaysWindow"] / most) * (width - left - right)
        # A bar with rounded right-hand corners
        bar = (f"M{left},{cy - 9:.1f} h{length - 4:.1f} q4,0 4,4 v10 q0,4 -4,4 "
               f"h{-(length - 4):.1f} Z")
        shapes.append(
            f'<g onclick="go(\'season\', {s["year"]})">'
            f'<rect class="hit" x="0" y="{i * row_height}" width="{width}" height="{row_height}"/>'
            + year_label(0, cy + 4, s["year"]) +
            f'<path d="{bar}" fill="var(--cedar)"/>'
            f'<text class="lbl-strong" x="{left + length + 6:.1f}" y="{cy + 4:.1f}">{s["sapDaysWindow"]} jours</text>'
            f'<text x="{width}" y="{cy + 4:.1f}" text-anchor="end">{number(s["totalGal"])}{NBSP}gal</text></g>'
        )

    return svg(width, height, "Jours de coulée par saison", shapes)

"""Quebec French formatting for numbers, temperatures and dates.

Every number or date the app shows passes through one of these functions,
so this is the place to change how "1 234,5 gal" or "1er mars" is written.
"""
import re
from datetime import date
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

# A space that never breaks across lines, so "12 gal" or "−3 °C" stay together.
NBSP = " "

MONTHS = ["janv.", "févr.", "mars", "avr.", "mai", "juin",
          "juil.", "août", "sept.", "oct.", "nov.", "déc."]
MONTHS_LONG = ["janvier", "février", "mars", "avril", "mai", "juin",
               "juillet", "août", "septembre", "octobre", "novembre", "décembre"]

# Python counts weekdays from Monday = 0.
WEEKDAYS = ["lundi", "mardi", "mercredi", "jeudi", "vendredi", "samedi", "dimanche"]
WEEKDAYS_SHORT = ["lun.", "mar.", "mer.", "jeu.", "ven.", "sam.", "dim."]


# ------------------------------------------------------------ numbers

def number(value, decimals=0):
    """1234.5 -> "1 234,5". Trailing zeros are dropped: 12.50 -> "12,5"."""
    if value is None:
        return "–"
    # Round halves up (217.25 -> 217.3). Plain Python rounding would give 217.2,
    # because 217.25 is stored as 217.2499999... inside the computer.
    rounded = Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(1).scaleb(-decimals), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    text = f"{rounded:,.{decimals}f}"        # "1,234.50"
    if decimals:
        text = text.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")  # "1,234.5"
    return text.replace(",", NBSP).replace(".", ",")


def percent(value):
    """-12.3 -> "12 %" (the sign is shown separately by whoever calls this)."""
    return f"{number(abs(value))}{NBSP}%"


def temperature(celsius):
    """-3.4 -> "−3 °C" (with a real minus sign, not a hyphen)."""
    if celsius is None:
        return "–"
    sign = "−" if celsius < 0 else ""
    return f"{sign}{abs(round(celsius))}{NBSP}°C"


def plural(amount, one, many):
    """French uses the singular below 2: "1,5 gallon", "2 gallons"."""
    return many if abs(amount) >= 2 else one


def snippet(text, max_length=110):
    """Shorten long logbook notes at a word boundary and add "…"."""
    if not text or len(text) <= max_length:
        return text or ""
    cut = text[:max_length]
    cut = re.sub(r"[\s;,]+\S*$", "", cut)  # drop the half-cut last word
    return cut + "…"


# ------------------------------------------------------------ dates
# Dates arrive from data.json as text like "2026-03-07".

def day_number(day):
    """The 1st of the month is written "1er" in French."""
    return "1er" if day == 1 else str(day)


def short_date(iso):
    """ "2026-03-07" -> "7 mars" """
    d = date.fromisoformat(iso)
    return f"{day_number(d.day)} {MONTHS[d.month - 1]}"


def long_date(iso):
    """ "2026-03-07" -> "7 mars 2026" """
    d = date.fromisoformat(iso)
    return f"{day_number(d.day)} {MONTHS_LONG[d.month - 1]} {d.year}"


def weekday(iso):
    """ "2026-03-07" -> "samedi" """
    return WEEKDAYS[date.fromisoformat(iso).weekday()]


def weekday_short(iso):
    """ "2026-03-07" -> "sam." """
    return WEEKDAYS_SHORT[date.fromisoformat(iso).weekday()]

The three charts need the page width, so they're empty slots (ui.output_ui) that app.py fills in: "yield_chart", "timing_chart", "sap_chart" -> charts.py """ import math import re from shiny import ui from components import callout, card, card_title, stat from data import (PANCAKE_STACKS_PER_GAL, SAP_RULE, SAP_TO_SYRUP_RATIO, SEASONS, UPDATED_ON, all_days, average_gal, biggest_day, on_shared_calendar) from french import NBSP, long_date, number, percent, short_date, snippet, temperature from icons import icon POUDING_PER_GAL = 16 # 1 cup of syrup per pouding chômeur (16 cups in a gallon) TARTE_PER_GAL = 10.666666 # 1.5 cup of syrup per tarte au sirop d'érable (16 cups in a gallon) GRUAU_PER_GAL = 16 * 12.5 # 1tbs (fort) of syrup per bol de gruau (16 cups in a gallon) QUEBECOIS_PER_GAL = 4 # 4 cup of syrup per Quebecer per year (16 cups in a gallon) def page(): first, last = SEASONS[0]["year"], SEASONS[-1]["year"] count = len(SEASONS) total_gal = sum(s["totalGal"] for s in SEASONS) average = average_gal() best = max(SEASONS, key=lambda s: s["totalGal"]) earliest = min(SEASONS, key=lambda s: on_shared_calendar(s["start"])) latest = max(SEASONS, key=lambda s: on_shared_calendar(s["end"])) return ui.div( card( ui.span(icon("leaf"), f" {first} – {last} · {count} saisons", class_="kicker"), ui.h1(f"{count} printemps sucrés"), ui.p("Chaque feu, chaque pot de beurre et chaque nuit de gel depuis le début du cahier.", class_="lede"), ui.div( stat("sun", "Eau d'érable", number(total_gal * SAP_TO_SYRUP_RATIO), unit="gal", note=f"bouillis, au ratio habituel de {number(SAP_TO_SYRUP_RATIO)} pour 1"), stat("drop", "Sirop", number(total_gal), unit="gal", note=f"environ {number(average)}{NBSP}gal par saison"), stat("jar", "Beurre d'érable", number(sum(s["butterPots"] for s in SEASONS)), unit="pots", note=f"de 500{NBSP}g chacun"), stat("flame", "Journées de bouillage", sum(s["boilDays"] for s in SEASONS), note="feux allumés et notés au cahier"), class_="stats", ), # callout("drop", f"C'est environ {number(total_gal * SAP_TO_SYRUP_RATIO)} gallons d'eau d'érable " # f"bouillis, au ratio habituel de {SAP_TO_SYRUP_RATIO} pour 1."), # class_="hero", ), card( card_title("Le sirop, saison par saison", "Gallons de sirop produits chaque printemps. Touchez une saison pour lire son histoire."), ui.output_ui("yield_chart", class_="chart"), callout("trophy", f"{best['year']} détient le record avec {number(best['totalGal'], 1)}{NBSP}gal, " f"soit {percent((best['totalGal'] - average) / average * 100)} au-dessus de la moyenne " f"des {count}{NBSP}saisons."), ), card( card_title("Quand l'eau a coulé", "Toutes les journées de bouillage sur un même calendrier. " "Plus le point est gros, plus la journée a été bonne."), ui.output_ui("timing_chart", class_="chart"), callout("cal", f"Premier feu le plus hâtif{NBSP}: {short_date(earliest['start'])} {earliest['year']}. " f"Dernière journée la plus tardive{NBSP}: {short_date(latest['end'])} {latest['year']}."), ), card( card_title("Le temps des sucres", f"Jours avec une nuit sous {number(SAP_RULE['nightBelowC'])}{NBSP}°C et un après-midi " f"au-dessus de {number(SAP_RULE['dayAboveC'])}{NBSP}°C, du 15 février au 20 avril."), ui.output_ui("sap_chart", class_="chart"), callout("snow", sap_weather_sentence()), ), card( card_title("Les records du cahier", "Les records de tous les temps du cahier. Touchez-en un pour voir la journée."), ui.div(*wall_of_fame(), class_="fame"), ), card( card_title("Équivalences gourmandes", "Comparatifs pour les dents sucrées."), ui.div(*gourmande(), class_="fame"), ), card( ui.h2("Le registre des saisons"), ledger(), ), footnote(), class_="view", ) def sap_weather_sentence(): """Which season had the most / fewest sap days, and did it matter?""" most = max(SEASONS, key=lambda s: s["sapDaysWindow"]) fewest = min(SEASONS, key=lambda s: s["sapDaysWindow"]) sentence = (f"{most['year']} a eu le plus de jours de coulée ({most['sapDaysWindow']}) " f"et {fewest['year']} le moins ({fewest['sapDaysWindow']}).") if fewest["totalGal"] >= average_gal(): sentence += (f" Pourtant, {fewest['year']} a quand même produit {number(fewest['totalGal'], 1)} gallons, " f"au-dessus de la moyenne. La météo ne fait pas tout{NBSP}: les lignes d'eau, le bois " f"et les longues journées au feu comptent aussi.") else: sentence += f" {fewest['year']} a aussi donné une récolte sous la moyenne." return sentence # ------------------------------------------------------------ wall of fame def fame_card(label, value, detail, icon_name, onclick=None, green=False): """One record. If onclick is given, tapping it opens the season (and day) it happened. Leave onclick out for a card that isn't clickable: Shiny drops attributes set to None, so the card gets no onclick, no hand cursor and no hover border. Season start / test…" """ return f"{lead}. {snippet(note)}" if note else f"{lead}." def fire_minutes(day): """How long the fire burned, from "08:15" and "17:45". 0 if unknown.""" start, end = day["fireStart"] or "", day["fireEnd"] or "" if not (re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,2}:\d{2}", start) and re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,2}:\d{2}", end)): return 0 def minutes(clock): hours, mins = clock.split(":") return int(hours) * 60 + int(mins) return max(0, minutes(end) - minutes(start)) def wall_of_fame(): days = all_days() cards = [] big = biggest_day(days) cards.append(fame_card( "La plus grosse journée", f"{number(big['gal'], 2)} gallons", with_note(long_date(big["date"]), big["notes"]), "flame", open_day(big))) best = max(SEASONS, key=lambda s: s["totalGal"]) cards.append(fame_card( "Meilleure saison", f"{best['year']}{NBSP}: {number(best['totalGal'], 1)}{NBSP}gal", f"« {best['title']} ». {best['boilDays']} journées de bouillage, {number(best['butterPots'])} pots de beurre.", "trophy", f"go('season', {best['year']})", green=True)) # Quand même {number(cold['gal'], 2)}{NBSP}gal produits.", "snow", open_day(cold))) # A day someone called the "worst day" in the logbook notes worst = next((day for day in days if "worst day" in (day["notes"] or "").lower()), None) if worst: cards.append(fame_card( "La journée la plus difficile", long_date(worst["date"]), worst["notes"], "storm", open_day(worst))) return cards def poudings(gallons): """How many whole poudings chômeur that much syrup can make.""" return math.floor(gallons * POUDING_PER_GAL) def tarte(gallons): """How many whole tarte au sirop d'érable that much syrup can make.""" return math.floor(gallons * TARTE_PER_GAL) def gruau(gallons): """How many whole bols de gruau that much syrup can make.""" return math.floor(gallons * GRUAU_PER_GAL) def quebecois(gallons): """How many quebequers can it feed for a year.""" return math.floor(gallons * QUEBECOIS_PER_GAL) def gourmande(): """Sweet comparisons: what all that syrup could turn into.""" cards = [] # All seasons together (not clickable: there's no single season to open) total_gal = sum(s["totalGal"] for s in SEASONS) cards.append(fame_card( "Pouding chômeur à l'érable", f"{number(poudings(total_gal))} poudings", f"Avec tout le sirop depuis {SEASONS[0]['year']}, à 1 tasse de sirop par pouding.", "flame")) cards.append(fame_card( "Tarte au sirop d'érable", f"{number(tarte(total_gal))} tartes", f"Avec tout le sirop depuis {SEASONS[0]['year']}, à 1.5 tasse de sirop par tarte.", "flame")) cards.append(fame_card( "Bols de gruau (à la Alain)", f"{number(gruau(total_gal))} bols", f"Avec tout le sirop depuis {SEASONS[0]['year']}, à 0.25 tasse de sirop par bol.", "flame")) cards.append(fame_card( "Québécois nourris pendant une année", f"{number(quebecois(total_gal))} personnes", f"Avec tout le sirop depuis {SEASONS[0]['year']}, à 4 tasses de sirop par personne par an.", "flame")) return cards cards.append(fame_card( "Tarte à l'érable", f"{number(big['gal'], 2)} gallons", with_note(long_date(big["date"]), big["notes"]), "flame", )) #
